Description: Infection of susceptible individuals. The force of infection is lambda(t) = beta * (I1(t) + I2(t)) / N.
Progression of exposed individuals from the first to the second stage at rate sigma.
Transition of exposed individuals to the infectious state at rate sigma.
Progression of infectious individuals from the first to the second stage at rate gamma.
Removal of infectious individuals to the removed compartment at rate gamma.

Name: N
Description: Total population size for each season analyzed.

Name: β
Description: The constant transmission rate. The model is re-parametrized in terms of other parameters (psi, lambda_0, pi) and beta is not directly inferred.

Name: σ
Description: Rate of becoming infectious (transition rate through E1 and E2). Assumed known. Corresponds to a mean incubation period d_L = 2/sigma days.

Name: γ
Description: Rate of recovery (transition rate through I1 and I2). Assumed known. Corresponds to a mean infectious period d_I = 2/gamma days.

Name: π
Description: The proportion of the population who is initially susceptible. Inferred parameter.

Name: λ_0
Description: The initial infection rate. Inferred parameter.

Name: ψ
Description: The exponential growth rate (EGR) at the start of the epidemic. Inferred parameter.

Name: p_ICU
Description: Probability of ICU admission given infection. Inferred parameter.

Name: η
Description: Over-dispersion parameter for the Negative Binomial observational model. Inferred parameter.

Name: σ^2_ICU|E
Description: Variance of time from infection to ICU admission. Assumed known from previous studies.

Name: R_0
Description: Basic reproduction number, the average number of successful transmissions per infectious person in a fully susceptible population. A derived quantity.

Name: R_n
Description: Effective reproduction number, the average number of successful transmissions per infectious person in a partially susceptible population. A derived quantity.
